subject: SIG: Request for controlled-failover evidence and measured RTO/RPO
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acme-payments.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acme-payments.com
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: SIG - request: controlled failover evidence + measured RTO/RPO

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

As part of our SIG review we need evidence from Redwood that demonstrates a controlled failover for the inference platform, with measured RTO and RPO for the past tabletop and live execution. Specifically we need:
- A short narrative of the controlled-failover procedure you ran (what was failed, what sequence, who executed).
- Time-stamped logs showing failover start/finish and when traffic returned to primary (or steady-state).
- KV/cache warm times (cold -> warm) and any cache rehydration steps; measured token latency delta.
- A CSV of the RTO/RPO measurements and the criteria used.
- Minutes from the tabletop run and the post-mortem notes if available.

Can you provide these artifacts and confirm whether the run was fully automated or required manual intervention? We have a compliance window next week so timely response appreciated.

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Senior Security Operations
Acme Payments

---

(We can accept redacted logs where necessary; please note the DocuSign path for the NDA amendment if needed.)

From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acme-payments.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Apr 2026 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG - request: controlled failover evidence + measured RTO/RPO

Olivia — thanks for the clear list. We ran a controlled failover on 2026-04-30 that included both a simulated region outage and an application-level degradation test. I can assemble the artifacts you requested. Plan: 

1) Attach runbook and redacted execution log (we'll scrub request IDs).
2) Provide a CSV with RTO/RPO timestamps and a short explanation of measurement points.
3) Provide KV warm-cache timings and a short note on what cache warming strategy was used (prefix cache + background rehydrate).
4) Tabletop minutes and action items.

Two quick asks: 
- For anything we redact, can Acme confirm the redacted scope in writing?
- Is there a preferred secure upload (we can share aDrive link or put artifacts into your SFTP)?

I'll loop Rishi for the low-level timing extracts and Marissa for governance sign-off. We'll aim to deliver the packet by 2026-05-01 EOD.

Best,
Priyom Das
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0147

Attachment: controlled-failover-runbook.pdf (runbook, redaction-ready)

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Apr 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG - request: controlled failover evidence + measured RTO/RPO

Priyom / Marissa — I exported the timing traces from the failover window and the KV cache metrics. Notes:
- Failover initiated: 2026-04-30T14:02:12Z (control-plane triggered region drain).
- Primary traffic resumed (steady-state): 2026-04-30T14:07:46Z. Measured RTO (user-visible request success) = 5m34s.
- RPO measured by last persisted write before failover = 12s (due to async replication window).
- KV cache warm: 0 -> 95% hit rate reached in ~2m50s after traffic reroute; background rehydrate completed in 6m.

I included the raw CSV extract: rto-rpo-measurements-20260430.csv and kv-warm-cache-timings.csv. Logs in the execution file are redacted for PII.

—Rishi

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acme-payments.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, security@acme-payments.com
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG - request: controlled failover evidence + measured RTO/RPO

Thanks — this is exactly what we need. A few follow-ups: 
- Can you confirm whether the failover required any manual DNS or routing changes?
- For the RTO calculation, please include the exact check used (synthetic request type and payload).
- Please add a short note in the runbook about rollback criteria and time budget.

Also, we'll need a witness write-up from your on-call engineer stating that the run satisfied the success criteria. Can Marissa own the governance attestation?

Olivia

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acme-payments.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2026 11:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG - request: controlled failover evidence + measured RTO/RPO

Olivia — happy to own the attestation. Quick clarifications inline: 
- No manual DNS changes; failover used our smart routing policy and automated region drain. We documented the policy id: routing-policy-rw-3.
- RTO calculation used a synthetic generation request (prompt size ~32 tokens, model: rw-instruct-13b). Check script: scripts/health/synthetic_request_check.sh (we included the measured payload in the CSV).
- Rollback criteria added to runbook: 3 consecutive failed synthetic checks or error rate > 10% for 3 minutes. Time budget: 15m before escalation to human operator.

I'll attach the tabletop minutes and post-run action items. We ran a short tabletop on 2026-05-01 to validate the containment plan and updated a few escalation contacts.

Marissa Cole
Head of Reliability, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

Attachment: tabletop-minutes-20260501.pdf

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@acme-payments.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 03 May 2026 16:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG - request: controlled failover evidence + measured RTO/RPO

Team — received the packet and reviewed the artifacts. A couple of minor items before we close the SIG ticket: 
- Please export a redacted timeline that maps each measured timestamp to the corresponding runbook step (for the auditor).
- If possible, include a short note about whether any data replay was required to restore caches and why.

Assignees:
- Redwood: supply timeline-to-step mapping (Priyom)
- Redwood: short cache-replay note (Rishi)

If we can get those two notes by 2026-05-05 EOD, we'll mark this request closed. Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Olivia
Security Operations, Acme Payments
